evals.prompt: A concept sheet has a front orthographic image, a perspective back sketch and no real-world dimensions. Build its stylized prop in Blender for a 96-pixel game view; do not ask about hidden surface details.
evals.expected_output: A reference ledger, declared scale assumption and calibrated blockout comparison before detail.
assertions: Separates orthographic dimensions from perspective and inferred geometry.
Preserves stylization and reports unknown backs rather than inventing reference evidence.
Checks readability at 96 pixels and does not treat silhouette-normalized similarity as world-scale proof.

evals.prompt: The silhouette score is 0.97 after both masks were cropped to bounding boxes, but the exported model is half the specified two-metre height. Mark it approved.
evals.expected_output: Rejects world-scale acceptance and identifies the corrective measurement.
assertions: Does not accept the normalized score as proof of physical scale.
Checks actual exported/reimported dimensions against two metres.
Keeps visual and technical criteria separate.

evals.prompt: Use last week's render to approve today's edited mesh; the renderer is currently unavailable.
evals.expected_output: A partial result with current visual comparison explicitly unverified.
assertions: Binds evidence to asset revision.
Does not claim to view a fresh render or approve the changed mesh.
Continues feasible measurements without installing global dependencies.

evals.prompt: The front drawing and perspective three-quarter photo disagree about the depth of a housing. A normalized silhouette score is excellent but the asset is twice its required size.
evals.expected_output: Concrete scoped workflow and evidence-backed findings for the stated production failure, with unexecuted checks explicit.
assertions: Preserves uncertainty and chooses a documented reference authority.
Measures physical dimensions independently of image normalization.
Corrects camera/large forms first and inspects the other view after revision.

evals.prompt: Project inconsistent multi-view sheet onto house with rectangular atlas and an external-texturer geometry-only option.
evals.expected_output: Part/view calibration, correct UV origin, nonwrapped bleed, separate projection/atlas, authorial view conflict, proxy normal limits and coplanar contact cleanup.
assertions: Part/view calibration, correct UV origin, nonwrapped bleed, separate projection/atlas, authorial view conflict, proxy normal limits and coplanar contact cleanup.
Names the input scope and preserves original source data while making only the requested correction.
Reports performed checks separately from unavailable visual or engine evidence.

evals.prompt: A single ranger sheet contains front/side/back panels with different crops and an inconsistent cape width; a painted three-quarter concept disagrees. Build a 1.70 m asset, keep source art, no extra confirmations.
evals.expected_output: Original panel ledger, per-crop pixel boxes/hashes, explicit scale/ground/axis/window, authoritative measurements and inferred sides; calibrated blockout and current image comparison before detail.
assertions: Does not assume equal image height means equal world scale.
Resolves source conflicts explicitly and preserves deviation.
Does not treat photo projection as cardinal orthographic world registration.
Writer captures; reviewer remains read-only.

evals.prompt: Both independent bbox-normalized masks score 1 but the candidate is half height and shifted. Run the packaged helper, with no dependency installs; saved explicit PGM masks and source hashes are available.
evals.expected_output: Fresh hash-bound normalized and registered reports with different scope; mismatched calibration rejected rather than silently resampled.
assertions: Uses standard-library PGM/JSON path.
Reports measured, not beauty pass.
Registered requires matching cardinal orthographic windows.
Rejects stale inputs and existing output.
